findings.action: Use the full descriptor matrix; retain cost, nonfinite-data and low-n limitations explicitly.
findings.confidence: High for execution and frozen source identities; descriptive geometry is observation-conditional.
findings.consequence: Broader structural diversity is measurable without assuming biological independence.
findings.observation: Complete paired X profiles increased from 56 to 137, while every one of 171 views is accounted for.

findings.action: Separate ordinary CV skill from matched stress deterioration; compare unit-free outcomes across targets.
findings.confidence: Native executable outcomes under frozen scopes; target meaning, missingness and physical dependencies remain source-specific.
findings.consequence: We can compare model response with pre-outcome descriptors, rather than infer predictive usefulness from X geometry alone.
findings.observation: 713 source/target tasks have complete fixed-model reference results; negative scores and failed folds are retained.

findings.action: Preserve the null screen, all negative-skill cases and the directly observed stress/pipeline contrasts.
findings.confidence: Descriptive post-hoc counterexample screen, not a preregistered H1-H5 decision rule.
findings.consequence: An empty threshold screen is a null result for that screen, not evidence that high concentration certifies generalization or low shortcut risk.
findings.observation: The post-hoc raw-PC1 >= .95 / negative-median-skill screen finds 0 cases; 11 source/family records have negative median skill overall.

findings.action: Use the paired effects as exploratory evidence and register later independent study validation separately.
findings.confidence: Exploratory paired evaluation; training composition and target support still limit causal interpretation.
findings.consequence: Neither a convenience bank nor many targets/folds establishes independent scientific replication.
findings.observation: 6 public source/family matched stress pairs are available; no independently confirmed study-level descriptor/fragility relationship exists.

findings.action: Retain the null screens and test prespecified matched fragility endpoints with independent study support.
findings.confidence: Native fixed-threshold descriptive tests on 15 to 35 permitted source views; no signed coefficient, adjustment or independent study inference.
findings.consequence: These screens provide no evidence of a strong linear source-view association with ordinary CV skill. They do not test every form of predictive usefulness or registered deterioration endpoint.
findings.observation: None of the six available descriptor screens exceeds absolute Pearson correlation .50 with median primary-task CV skill for either fixed model.

findings.action: Preserve estimator-by-pipeline interactions and extend matched, prospectively specified context comparisons.
findings.confidence: Executed raw/SNV contrasts with identical evaluation IDs, exact training-size controls and a common null denominator; small exploratory context populations.
findings.consequence: Preprocessing sensitivity depends on both source context and estimator; no universal SNV correction or scalar shortcut ranking follows.
findings.observation: SNV increases matched stress deterioration for both models on aquatic-leaf LMA, reduces it on tablets, and has opposite signs for PLS and Ridge on leaf nitrogen.

findings.action: Retain small, negative and estimator-opposed effects; use matched-size designs before interpreting grouping effects causally.
findings.confidence: Five metadata-selected declared-plot tasks, common evaluation observations; training sizes and compositions differ and plots are not independently verified biological units.
findings.consequence: Grouping effects are heterogeneous; a stronger declared grouping does not guarantee a uniform direction or magnitude of score change.
findings.observation: Whole-plot CV worsens both fixed models on pressed-leaf nitrogen, but improves PLS and worsens Ridge on the Plant_Age task; NASA-leaf EWT changes are close to zero.
